[Extended-valued convex extension] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0436 1. apph:H.4\group Euclidean convexity If $C\subset \R ^n$ is convex and $f:C\to \R $ is convex, its extension by $+\infty $ outside $C$ is convex on all of $\R ^n$.
